items.exampleEn: Some animals eat bark in winter.
items.exampleZh: 冬天時，有些動物會吃樹皮。

items.exampleEn: Breeding dogs takes a lot of time and money.
items.exampleZh: 繁殖狗需要花很多時間和金錢。

items.exampleEn: Some people live close to a volcano.
Many colorful fish live around the reef.
items.exampleZh: 許多色彩繽紛的魚住在礁石周圍。

items.exampleEn: Don't touch the freezing metal with wet hands.
items.exampleZh: 別用濕的手去碰冰冷的金屬。

items.exampleEn: My little brother keeps a turtle as a pet.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟養了一隻烏龜當寵物。

items.exampleEn: The farmer has a large flock of sheep.
Mules can carry heavy things on mountain roads.
items.exampleZh: 騾子能在山路上載運重物。

items.sentenceEn: It's freezing in here! Close the window.

items.audioEn: We can't swim near the reef today because the waves are too big.
items.audioZh: 今天浪太大，我們不能在礁石附近游泳。
items.questionZh: 為什麼今天不能在礁石附近游泳？

items.sentenceEn: A flock of ducks swam across the lake.
Smoke is coming out of the volcano.

items.stemEn: The ____ is so old that its shell is covered with green plants.
items.stemZh: 那隻烏龜太老了，殼上長滿了綠色植物。

items.stemEn: It was ____ last night, so the water outside turned to ice.
items.stemZh: 昨晚冷得要命，外面的水都結冰了。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my family visited a small island with an old volcano. The volcano has not been active for many years. In the morning, we went diving near a reef and saw a big sea turtle swimming slowly. In the afternoon, we tried to walk up the hill, but the path was too steep for us, so a farmer let us ride his mule. On the way, a flock of birds flew over our heads. The farmer told us that spring is the breeding season for these birds. He also showed us that the bark of some trees can be used to make baskets. At night, the wind was freezing, and we sat close to the fire.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們全家去了一座有古老火山的小島。那座火山已經很多年沒有活動了。早上，我們在礁石附近潛水，看到一隻大海龜在水中慢慢前進。下午我們試著往山上走，但小路對我們來說太陡了，所以一位農夫讓我們騎他的騾子。路上，一群鳥從我們頭上飛過。農夫告訴我們，春天是這些鳥的繁殖季節。他還告訴我們，有些樹的樹皮可以用來編籃子。晚上，風冷得刺骨，我們靠著火坐在一起。

questions.questionZh: 他們在礁石附近看到什麼？
為什麼農夫讓他們騎騾子？
options: 因為小路對他們來說太陡了
因為他們走錯了路，天色又快黑了

referenceEn: The mule refused to move forward.
The mule refused to go forward.
rubricZh: mule 表示「騾子」，例如 ride a mule 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 湖水冰冷，沒有人敢下去游泳。
referenceEn: The lake water was freezing, so nobody dared to swim.
The water in the lake was freezing, and no one dared to go in.
rubricZh: 用 freezing 表示「極冷的」
時態配合內容（例如 was、is 等）
